intuition: Keep iterators for the current nesting levels and descend only when the next item is a list.

brute_force.approach: Recursively flatten the entire input into a second list before iteration.
brute_force.time: construction O(n), next O(1), hasNext O(1)

optimal.approach: Use a stack of list iterators and expand nested lists lazily until an integer is ready.
optimal.time: next O(1) amortized, hasNext O(depth) amortized

edge_cases: Nested lists may contain other lists several levels deep.
An empty nested list contributes no values.
